title: Ford F-250 Engines by Year (1953–1997)
description: Every factory engine in the Ford F-250 three-quarter-ton pickup by year, 1953–1997: sixes, Y-block and FE V8s, the 460, the IDI diesels and the first Power Stroke.
intro: The F-250 was Ford's three-quarter-ton pickup from 1953 until the Super Duty replaced it; the last old-body F-250 Heavy Duty was a 1997 model. Later F-250s are on the Super Duty page.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
Sixes, the 239 flathead and then Y-block V8s.
The 223 six and the 272 and 292 Y-blocks.
The 223 and 262 sixes and the 292, then the 240 and 300 sixes and the FE 352.
The 240 and 300 sixes and the FE 360 and 390. Ratings are SAE net from 1972.
The 300 six, 302, 351 and 460 V8s and, from 1983, the International 6.9 diesel.
Fuel-injected gasoline engines and the 7.3 IDI diesel.
The 4.9, 5.0, 5.8 and 7.5 gasoline engines, the IDI diesels and, from mid-1994, the 7.3 Power Stroke.
